business_summary: Barrick Mining Corporation engages in the exploration, development, production, and sale of mineral properties. It explores for gold, copper, silver, and energy materials. The company was formerly known as Barrick Gold Corporation and changed its name to Barrick Mining Corporation in May 2025. Barrick Mining Corporation was founded in 1983 and is based in Toronto, Canada.
business_summary_ko: Barrick Mining Corporation은 광물 자산의 탐사, 개발, 생산 및 판매에 종사하고 있습니다. 금, 구리, 은, 에너지 소재를 탐구합니다. 이 회사는 이전에 Barrick Gold Corporation으로 알려졌으며 2025년 5월에 Barrick Mining Corporation으로 이름을 변경했습니다. Barrick Mining Corporation은 1983년에 설립되었으며 캐나다 토론토에 본사를 두고 있습니다.
